preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of roads must be exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= s <= n and 1 <= t <= n and s != t for s, t in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct cities within the valid range.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the minimum number of inversions followed by the sorted list of possible capital cities.
The minimum number of inversions must be non-negative.
There must be at least one possible capital city.
